paper_title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
caption: Audio-only back-end modules FLOPs (Billion).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the FLOPs (Floating Point Operations) of audio-only back-end Conformer modules across three stages.  The horizontal axis represents the stages: Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3, with descriptive text below each stage indicating parameters: Stage 1 (d=180, n=500), Stage 2 (d=256, n=250), and Stage 3 (d=360, n=125). The vertical axis, labeled "Module Giga FLOPS", displays values ranging from 0 to 0.3, with evenly spaced tick labels at 0, 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3. Three bar groups are present for each stage, corresponding to "attention", "grouped attention (g=3)", and "patch attention (k=3)" as indicated by a legend; the attention bars are blue, grouped attention bars are orange, and patch attention bars are green. For Stage 1, the blue "attention" bar has an approximate value of 0.28, while the green "patch attention" bar has an approximate value of 0.13.  Stage 2 presents a similar arrangement, with the attention bar reaching approximately 0.25, and patch attention slightly below 0.1. In Stage 3, the blue "attention" bar has a value of around 0.12, the orange "grouped attention" bar has a value of approximately 0.1, and the green "patch attention" bar around 0.07. The bars within each stage group appear to be sorted in descending order by value, with the bars representing the "attention" module generally taller than the "grouped attention" or "patch attention" bars. No bars are visibly emphasized through shading, bolding, or other visual distinctions.
